integrity: Exact all-parameter proof from the vertex deletion/link mapping cone and integral join signs; independent finite enumeration and signed Lefschetz checks corroborate selected cases. No claims of independent verification, authorship, publication priority or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The group action is determined on integral homology but no equivariant wedge equivalence is claimed. Quotient-space homology is determined only over the rationals. The finite verifier covers parameters 2 through 4 and does not establish the infinite theorem.
title: Two integral symmetry characters of hexagonal bouquets
